sources.primary_title: MXVi Takes a Huge Leap Forward in Saudi Arabia
sources.verified_angle_summary: MXVi, a provider of mission-critical vehicle intelligence systems, announced its participation at LEAP 2026 alongside Aramco Digital. The company is presenting its Vi5 in-vehicle device, which supports legacy mobile radio and mission-critical LTE/5G. MXVi also revealed it has been awarded a major contract in Saudi Arabia, marking a significant milestone in its global expansion following deployments with the UK Home Office and a major European airport. This represents a concrete business win and product showcase for the region.
